parameters.content: Manual retrieval benchmark. Import and bind the published 04_rag_search workflow ID. Run after indexing the labelled internal project documents. Record the n8n execution ID and hit@5 before accepting Gate B.

parameters.jsCode:
const pairs=[
['Find GCP Snowflake Terraform Airflow warehouse work','corpus/project/1/projet_13.txt'],
['Trouver un entrepôt analytique GCP Snowflake Terraform Airflow','corpus/project/1/projet_13.txt'],
['Salesforce Lightning customer portal implementation','corpus/project/1/projet_12.txt'],
['Portail client Salesforce Lightning','corpus/project/1/projet_12.txt'],
['Azure HR data centralization across subsidiaries','corpus/project/1/projet_15.txt'],
['Centralisation des données RH des filiales sur Azure','corpus/project/1/projet_15.txt'],
['Azure Kubernetes Snowflake predictive maintenance','corpus/project/1/projet_14.txt'],
['Maintenance prédictive avec Azure Kubernetes et Snowflake','corpus/project/1/projet_14.txt'],
['Talend Kafka Airflow retail data integration','corpus/project/1/projet_01.txt'],
['Intégration des données retail avec Talend Kafka Airflow','corpus/project/1/projet_01.txt']];
return pairs.map(([query,expected],i)=>({json:{schema_version:1,job_id:null,lead_id:null,operation:'rag_search',context:{query_id:'Q-'+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'),expected_document_id:expected,language:i%2?'fr':'en'},input:{query,top_k:5,asset_type:'project'},result:null,warnings:[]}}));

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(rows.length!==10)throw Error('Incomplete labelled benchmark');const results=rows.map(r=>{const expected=String(r.context?.expected_document_id??'');const ids=(r.result?.documents??[]).map(d=>String(d.document_id));return {query_id:r.context?.query_id,language:r.context?.language,expected_document_id:expected,returned_document_ids:ids,hit_at_5:ids.includes(expected)}});const hits=results.filter(r=>r.hit_at_5).length;return [{json:{schema_version:1,job_id:null,lead_id:null,operation:'rag_evaluation',input:{labelled_queries:10,execution_id:$execution.id},result:{hits,hit_at_5:hits/10,gate_passed:hits>=8,queries:results},warnings:hits>=8?[]:['Retrieval Gate B is below 8/10']}}];

parameters.query: WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb j) INSERT INTO public.rag_evaluation_runs(execution_id,labelled_queries,hits,hit_at_5,results) SELECT j->'input'->>'execution_id',(j->'input'->>'labelled_queries')::integer,(j->'result'->>'hits')::integer,(j->'result'->>'hit_at_5')::numeric,j->'result'->'queries' FROM p RETURNING id;
